senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חטר) [to cut off, surround,] to wreathe, adorn.—Part. pass. עָטוּר.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 9">Pesik. R. s. 9</cite>, beg. <he>כוס … שיהא מודח ושיהא ע׳ וכ׳</he> the goblet of benediction must be cleansed (shining), wreathed and full; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:5:7">Y. Ber. VII, end, 11ᵈ</cite> <he>מלא ע׳ ומודח</he> (not <cite ref="P00533"><he>עיטור</he></cite>), v. infra.
<cite ref="Berakhot 51a">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ י׳ מְעַטְּרֵהוּ בתלמידים</he> R. J. wreathed it (the goblet of benediction) by placing scholars around it (v. supra).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:9">Bicc. III, 9</cite> <he>מְעַטְּרִין את וכ׳</he> the first fruits must be decorated with plants not belonging to the seven kinds of fruits. Y. ib. 65ᶜ <he>היה מְעַטְּרָן תאנים</he> decorated them with figs. Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵇ bot.

<cite ref="Beitzah 5a:9">Bets. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי לעַטֵּר שוקי וכ׳</he> in order to have the markets of Jerusalem decorated with fruits; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְעוּטָּר</he>; f. <he>מְעוּטֶּרֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְעוּטָּרִים</he>, <he>מְעוּטָּרִין</he>; <he>מְעוּטָרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:4">Ab. Zar. I, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 12b:7">12ᵇ</cite>) <he>חניות מע׳</he> wreathed shops (in honor of the deity of the bazaar). Y. ib. I, 39ᵈ <he>במה מע׳</he> wherewith are they wreathed (in order to be recognized as dedicated to a deity)?; a. e.

senses.gloss: to crown, offer a crown. Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 והיו … ומְעַטְּרִין אותו and all the chiefs came and crowned him (Pharaoh); Ex. R. s. 5 מַעֲטִירִין (Hif.).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:14">Ib.</cite> <he>משעִטְּרוּ אותו</he> after they had crowned him.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:8">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> <he>מדינה … לעַטֵּר למלך</he> a country that sent a delegate to offer the king a crown (of fealty); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be surrounded, protected, saved. Tanḥ. Tol’doth 4 (ref. to Prov. XVII, 6) הצדיקים מִתְעַטְּרִין בבני בניהם ובניהם מתעטרין באבותם the righteous are saved for the sake of their grandchildren, and their children for the sake of their fathers; אברהם נתע בזכות וכ׳ Abraham was saved (from the furnace) for the sake of Jacob &c.
units: <cite ref="Proverbs 17:6">Ib.</cite> <he>יצחק נתע׳ וכ׳</he> Isaac was protected through Abraham, and Abraham through Isaac.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 47">Gen. R. s. 47</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 12:4">Prov. XII, 4</cite>, as applied to Sarah) <he>בעלה נתע׳ בה והיא לא נִתְעַטְּרָה בבעלה</he> her husband was protected through her, but she was not protected through him; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be crowned, adorned, distinguished. Y. Snh. II, 20ᵇ top (ref. to I Chr. II, 24; 26) הוא ירחמאל קדמוי גויה להִתְעַטֵּר בה … it is the Jerahmeel mentioned before, only that he married a gentile woman (named עטרה) to be ennobled through her; Ruth R. end. Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ bot. אותה עטרה … להתעטר בה the Lord has left to him this crown to be crowned with it (this distinction to become renowned by it), v. גָּדַר; a. e.
